items.why: Together AI raised preemptible GPU Cluster hourly rates by one cent: H100 $1.99 → $2.00 and H200 $2.99 → $3.00.

record.short: Together AI’s preemptible H100 rate rose $1.99 → $2.00 per GPU-hour and H200 $2.99 → $3.00.
record.headline: Together AI raised its preemptible GPU Cluster rates by one cent per GPU-hour, H100 to $2.00 and H200 to $3.00.
record.who: Customers running preemptible (pay-as-you-go) H100 and H200 GPU clusters; reserved and on-demand rates were not reported as changed.
record.read: The move is tiny (about 0.3–0.5%) but continuous, high-utilisation workloads pay it on every GPU-hour. It looks like fine-tuning of compute rates rather than a repositioning.
record.caveat: Both figures come from saved third-party captures of the page; the company has given no reason.
